'''Scope''' was a [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone snowtrooper]] serving in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They served in the [[Skirmish on Carlac]] alongside a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi General]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]], and other members of the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]]. Scope was stationed at the [[Republic Outpost (Carlac)|Republic Outpost]], working as a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] vendor.<ref name="CWA" />
